title: Yoda
description: Lying injured on the frozen waste of Hoth, Luke Skywalker is instructed by the Force spirit of Obi-Wan Kenobi to seek the Jedi Master Yoda in the Dagobah system. Once there, Luke and R2-D2 encountered a diminutive being, and were surprised to discover he was Yoda. Yoda trained Luke, but Luke struggled with his belief. When Luke left for Cloud City to rescue his friends, Yoda urged him to stay and complete his training.
